answer: Inviter liability: each new agent must be sponsored by an established one, who locks part of its own stake as a bond that is forfeited if the newcomer is later caught as a sybil. Think of a wharf where no boat docks unless a known captain vouches for it, the vouch acting as a bridge of trust. Growing a grove of fake identities then means burning real stake per invite or corrupting honest sponsors, so attack cost rises with every fake.
